gen-gf-offside-gf-aclonica: Offside draws curves that refuse to close, all in one marker-like line. Aclonica counters with a deep-bodied lowercase whose bowls thin gently, stretched wide across the line.
gen-gf-offside-gf-allerta: Wire-smooth and wide-spaced. Offside glides along with no weight accents, while Allerta follows in loose tracking and a prominent x-height that keeps every line easy to scan.
gen-gf-offside-gf-alumni-sans: Offside leads with open curves and flat, contrast-free letters. Alumni Sans is the sturdier partner, its bowls swelling slightly and its ascenders barely clearing the x-height, which makes the two feel steady.
gen-gf-offside-gf-alumni-sans-sc: Alumni Sans SC reads neutral and contemporary, with lowercase that looks oversized beside its capitals and stems just heavier than hairlines. Offside above it keeps a skimming, unchanging stroke.
gen-gf-offside-gf-anaheim: Anaheim packs its rounded, open-sided letters into a dense huddle where lowercase fills the line like capitals. And Offside, with zero stroke contrast and wide tracking, spreads out above it like a quiet runway.
gen-gf-offside-gf-cal-sans: Bold, rounded and friendly. Offside brings widely tracked curves that refuse to close, and Cal Sans follows with one stroke width, short ascenders and a tall x-height.
gen-gf-offside-gf-carlito: Carlito reads clearly, its round open letters tightly spaced like thread on a spool, with small capitals beside big lowercase. And Offside does the opposite job, gliding in wide tracking with a plain, unshaded line.
gen-gf-offside-gf-days-one: Offside has almost no stroke contrast, just a level, widely tracked line with curves that never quite close. Days One answers by filling the line with a tall x-height.
gen-gf-offside-gf-farro: Offside's curves refuse to close, and its widely tracked line has no weight accents. Farro goes the other way, with compressed ascenders and no stroke contrast, so text moves along smoothly.
gen-gf-offside-gf-geist-mono: Commanding and expressive, Offside stretches its open curves in wide tracking and a level beat. And Geist Mono sets fixed-width, code-style letters with high lowercase and big side gaps, giving it a structured feel.
